intro.title: How much do you really need to buy?
intro.text: Price, fees, Bëllegen Akt, deposit: in a few minutes you know where you stand. Your budget is shown without sign-up.

coach.step1: Hello! I’m Jason. These questions change the calculation a lot.
coach.step2: Up to 3 municipalities: I’ll show you what your budget means there.
coach.step4: This helps me get back to you at the right time.
coach.step5: Your number is only used to talk about your search.
coach.vendre: Good to know: I can also value the property you are selling.
coach.premierOui: First purchase: the bank may lend up to 100% of the price.
coach.investir: For a buy-to-let, the bank lends at most 80% of the price.
coach.renover: With my ImmoBuild team, I can help you cost the works.
coach.courtier: Great: our partner broker will contact you after your request.
coach.mandat: Happy to, let’s talk about it on the phone.

fields.premier: Is this your first purchase with a mortgage in Luxembourg?
fields.premierHelp: As defined by the CSSF: nobody has ever had a home loan for a property in Luxembourg. As a couple, you must both be first-time buyers.
fields.bellegen: Have you already used the “Bëllegen Akt” tax credit?
fields.bellegenHelp: It reduces the registration fees when you buy a home to live in.
fields.vendre: Do you need to sell a property first?
fields.vendreNote: Need to sell first? Get a free valuation of your property:
fields.communesHelp: Up to 3. Type a name, then pick it from the list.
fields.communesFull: You have chosen 3 municipalities. Remove one to add another.
fields.renover: Would you buy a property that needs renovation?
fields.notePlaceholder: School within walking distance, quiet, near the station…
fields.apportHelp: Your savings for the purchase, without your safety reserve.
fields.prix: Purchase price you have in mind
fields.prixHelp: A rough figure is enough. You can change it later.
fields.banque: Have you already talked to your bank?
fields.capacite: Do you know how much you can borrow?
fields.capaciteMontantHelp: If you know it, I’ll also calculate your maximum price.
fields.revenuHelp: To compare the example monthly payment with your income. This is not a loan assessment.
fields.courtier: I would like to be put in touch, with no commitment, with our partner mortgage broker.
fields.courtierHint: Did you know that rates are negotiated case by case? A broker compares several banks for you, free of charge.
fields.courtierName: Our partner broker is {nom}. They only receive your details if you tick this box.
fields.delai: When do you want to buy?
fields.mandat: Would you like help negotiating the price and having a property’s condition checked before signing?
fields.numeroWhy: To talk about your search. Never any cold calls.
fields.alerte: Let me know if a matching property comes in at ImmoBuild.
fields.honeypot: Do not fill in this field
fields.rgpd: I agree that ImmoBuild Kohn may use my answers to contact me about my search ({link}).

budget.title: Your budget for {prix}
budget.sub: Indicative calculation based on the public rules in force on {date}.
budget.droitsMax: New build: 7% at most. Duties often apply only to the land and the part already built.
budget.bellegenNone: No Bëllegen Akt for a buy-to-let.
budget.bellegenUsed: Already used: you may have some left. Check with your notary.
budget.bellegenNsp: Calculated as if you had not used it yet. Please check. The administration always collects at least €100.
budget.bellegenAnnonce: {montant} per person has been announced for deeds since 16/07/2026, but the law has not been passed yet (as of {date}). The calculation uses the current amount.
budget.fraisPretNote: Estimate: to be confirmed by your notary.
budget.pret: Maximum loan under the CSSF rule
budget.pretCapacite: Loan used (the amount you gave me)

ltv.premier: First purchase to live in: up to 100% of the price.
ltv.residence: Main residence: as a rule up to 90% of the price (banks may exceed this for a limited share of their loans).
ltv.incertain: First-time buyer status unknown: cautious calculation at 90%. 100% if you are a first-time buyer.
ltv.investissement: Buy-to-let: up to 80% of the price.

budget.ltvNote: This is a legal ceiling. Your bank decides and may ask for a larger deposit.
budget.ok: Under the CSSF rule, your deposit covers the minimum for this price, if your bank lends you this amount. Your income counts too.
budget.manque: For this price, you are short of about {montant} of deposit under the CSSF rule.
budget.pistes: Options: a slightly lower price, buying as a couple, state aid, or talking to a broker.
budget.prixMax: With your deposit and a {pret} loan, your maximum price is about {prix}.
budget.disclaimer: This tool is neither credit advice nor a loan offer. Only your bank decides.
budget.next: What your budget means in your municipalities and a call from Jason: 2 more steps.

result.title: Thank you {prenom}, your analysis is ready
result.sub: Jason has received it too and will call you to talk it through.
result.communesSub: Approximate living area at the municipality’s average price per m².

source.canton: median of sales in the canton ({n} municipalities)
source.annonce: {n} listings: asking prices, not sale prices
source.canton_annonce: median of listings in the canton ({n} municipalities): asking prices

result.communesNote: Source: Observatoire de l’Habitat, {debut} to {fin}. Municipal average: depending on the neighbourhood, condition and floor, a property can cost much more or less.
result.checkPremier: First-time buyer status: confirm with your bank (CSSF definition).
result.checkRevenu: Banks often check that the monthly payment stays below roughly one third to 40% of net income. This is not a legal rule: your bank decides.
result.checkAides: Possible aid depending on income: prime d’accession, prime d’épargne, interest subsidy, state guarantee.
result.vendreText: Value your property in 2 minutes, then we plan both sales together.
result.renoverText: It can be a good deal if you know the cost of the works. With ImmoBuild, I can help you cost them.
result.mandatText: Negotiating the price, checking the condition, reading the terms before signing: let’s talk on the phone.
result.courtierText: Our partner broker will contact you, with no commitment.
result.agentText: I’ll call you to talk about your search. I also know properties that are not online yet.
result.ancienPourNeuf: Existing-home prices (too few new-build sales here): new builds usually cost more, so fewer m².

trust.where: Your answers are emailed to ImmoBuild Kohn only, and to our partner broker only if you asked for it.

mensualite.title: Example monthly payment
mensualite.sub: For a {pret} loan, at the average rates of new home loans in Luxembourg (BCL, {mois}). Insurance not included.
mensualite.partRange: Over 25 years at a fixed rate, that is about {min} to {max} of your net income.
mensualite.partMin: Over 25 years at a fixed rate, that is at least {min} of your net income.
mensualite.partMax: Over 25 years at a fixed rate, that is at most {max} of your net income.
mensualite.repere_low: That is rather below the usual bank guideline (about one third to 40%).
mensualite.repere_mid: That is within the usual bank guideline (about one third to 40%).
mensualite.repere_high: That is rather above the usual bank guideline (about one third to 40%): a longer term, a lower price or a larger deposit can help.
mensualite.disclaimer: Example based on average rates: neither an offer nor your rate. Your rate depends on your bank and your situation.
